text:
Priya M: Quick plan — run a tight PLG mini-launch next week: 3 prompt-pack variants (starter, ui-helper, reranker), 50/75/100 credit audiences, and one 25-min walkthrough webinar. Primary KPI = 7-day DAU-from-signup lift, secondary = avg tokens/use and prompt conversion benchmarks. Aim to ship fast and measure. Thoughts?

Jonas H: Love it. Suggest we randomize at signup so attribution is clean (assign `prompt_pack_experiment` on user create). Gate credit grant on `used_prompt` event within 48h. We'll need cohort windows defined for reporting. :white_check_mark:

Riley T: Copy + creative notes: play up "ship a prototype" for devs, and "bootstrap responses" for PMs. Short in-app card copy options:
- "Starter prompts: build an LLM prototype in minutes"
- "UI helper prompts: reduce UI logic work"
- "Reranker prompts: better search results out of the box"
Also recommend inline code preview + GIF of 1 prompt in action.

Nia S: Webinar: 25-minute live demo + 10-min Q&A, run two times (Amer/EMEA). We'll record and attach to email drip. Topic: "From signup to prototype: prompt packs and credits". I'll own registration page + calendar links.

Priya M: Measurement: Amplitude events = signup, assigned_prompt_pack, used_prompt, claim_credit, webinar_attend, routed_mql. We'll track `prompt_template_id` and `first_model_variant` as user props. Baseline conversion rates please.

Jonas H: I'll post SQL for cohorts: 7-day activation = users with >=1 used_prompt within 7 days. Also compute avg tokens per session and prompt drop-off after first try.

Riley T: Email nurture sequence (short):
1) Welcome: quick CTA to try starter prompt (trigger: immediately)
2) 24h: "See the walkthrough" + webinar invite (if not registered)
3) 72h: credit reminder if used_prompt not fired
Copy samples posted: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/mini-launch-copy (links in thread)

ops-bot: Campaign created: campaign_id=camp_minilaunch_202604. Include tag `campaign:camp_minilaunch_202604` on all events. Experiment assignment property: `prompt_pack_variant`.

Nia S: Registration will include hidden utm params and `experiment_variant` to feed into the analytics pipeline. We'll also add a checkbox to opt-in for sales contact.

Jonas H: Routing rules: attendees who used_prompt -> sales-lo with tag `mini-launch-attended-usedprompt`. Non-attendees who used_prompt -> marketing nurture only. Sales-lo-bot: confirm mapping?

sales-lo-bot: Mapping confirmed. Route to SDR pool A for dev persona, pool B for PM persona. Add `lead_score` property based on tokens used > 500 in first 7 days.

Priya M: Benchmarks to capture during the experiment:
- used_prompt rate by variant
- avg tokens per successful session by variant
- percent who claim credits after using prompt
- webinar attendance lift from email vs in-app card
Set lookback window 14 days for secondary metrics.

Riley T: Small UX ask: show credit balance toast right after used_prompt event so people know they got the credits. Ops will need to call grant endpoint and record `claimed_credit=true` when toast viewed.

ops-bot: Grant flow: POST /internal/grants with body { user_id, amount, campaign } and emit event `credit_granted`. Ensure idempotency key: `grant:campaign:user_id`.

Priya M: Action items: Jonas 1) setup experiment assignment + SQL cohorts by EOD Fri. 2) event definitions in amplitude. Riley 1) finalize copy + GIFs. Nia 1) registration page + webinar times. Ops 1) implement grant endpoint and confirm event tags. I'll track in growth board and report first snapshot after 200 signups per variant.

Jonas H: Will also add a checksum to the assignment so we can validate randomization balance.

Riley T: Let's keep the creative friction minimal — 1-click "Try starter prompt" that injects code into the playground.

Nia S: I'll coordinate recordings and make the replay available in the 24h email.

Priya M: Timeline: build this week, launch Monday AM, stop after 10 days or when each variant reaches 500 signups. Small and measurable. :rocket:
